newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 13.76 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 13.76 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks fell for the third month running in July, a monthly Reuter poll of the 25 biggest banks showed on Thursday.
Banks predicted average year-on-year inflation for the end of 1997 at 13.76 percent, down from 14.62 percent predicted last month but above the government's goal of 13 percent.
The average July inflation forecast was 0.48 percent.
NOTE: In brackets previous figures for end-97 and June-98 from last month's poll. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
